name: const unsafe fn sub (self , count : usize) -> Self where T : Sized ,
rule: For safety, if count * size_of::<T>() is non-zero, the memory range between self and the pointer resulting from subtracting count elements of T must not wrap around the edge of the address space.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > * const T { const unsafe fn sub (self , count : usize) -> Self where T : Sized , }
